Application Data.NAME: XYZ Countertop Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: XYZ Countertop Solutions specializes in the installation of countertops and surfaces for residential and commercial clients. Our services include measuring, templating, and fabricating various materials such as granite, quartz, and laminate. We operate primarily from our showroom, with less than 25% of our work performed offsite. In addition to installation, we offer maintenance services and collaborate with local contractors for renovations. We prioritize quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring all installations are performed by trained professionals. Our operations are conducted in a secure environment to mitigate risks associated with inventory theft and damage to valuable fixtures.
